widget.name: World Map
widget.description: World Map SVG Mendix Pluggable Widget based on https://yanivam.github.io/react-svg-worldmap

property.caption: Country ISO
property.description: Country ISO Code.

property.caption: Value
property.description: Country value. May be a string or a number.

property.caption: Value suffix
property.description: Text shown after the value in the country tooltip (e.g. "people"). Leave empty for no suffix.

property.caption: Size
property.description: Width of the map.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Color for highlighted countries (e.g. "red" or "#ff0000").

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Atlas: blue water, slate borders and light land for countries without data, with borders that stay one pixel wide when zoomed in.

property.caption: On Click
property.description: Action to be executed when a country is clicked.

property.caption: Zoom and pan
property.description: Let users zoom and pan the map with the zoom buttons, by dragging, by double-clicking, with the keyboard and with Ctrl/Cmd + mouse wheel. A plain mouse wheel still scrolls the page.

property.caption: Maximum zoom
property.description: How far users can zoom in, as a multiple of the whole map. From 2 to 20.

property.caption: Zoom buttons
property.description: Show the zoom in, zoom out and reset buttons in the bottom-right corner of the map.

property.caption: Country names
property.description: Show the names of countries they fit inside. More names appear as users zoom in.

property.caption: Country name color
property.description: Color of the country names (e.g. "#222222"). Leave empty for the default dark gray.

property.caption: Detailed borders
property.description: Draw sharper country borders and coastlines when zoomed in. They are downloaded once (about 2.4 MB, less when the server compresses it), as soon as a user points at the map.

property.caption: Detailed borders from zoom
property.description: The zoom level at which the detailed borders are drawn. At most the maximum zoom.

property.caption: Regions
property.description: When zoomed in, draw the borders of the states, provinces or other regions of the countries in view, as dashed lines. Needs zoom and pan, and region data in GeoJSON format (see Region data URL).

property.caption: Regions from zoom
property.description: The zoom level at which regions are loaded and drawn. At most the maximum zoom.

property.caption: Region data URL
property.description: Address of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with one country's regions (Polygon or MultiPolygon features). {code} is replaced by the country's two-letter ISO code in upper case, e.g. "regions/{code}.geojson" or "https://example.com/admin1/{code}.json". A relative address is relative to the app's root URL, so files in the theme's web folder work. Each country is loaded once.

property.caption: Countries with regions
property.description: Two-letter ISO codes of the countries the Region data URL has data for, separated by commas (e.g. "US, CA, BR"). Leave empty to try every country in view; countries without a file are then requested and skipped.

property.caption: Region name property
property.description: The GeoJSON feature property that holds the region's name, e.g. "name" or "shapeName".

property.caption: On region status change
property.description: Runs when a country's regions start loading, finish loading, aren't available or fail to load, and when regions are hidden again (status "idle", no country).

property.caption: Pins
property.description: Markers with a caption, drawn at a latitude and longitude, with or without zoom. When pins overlap, the one that comes first in the list is shown.

property.caption: Latitude
property.description: Latitude in degrees, from -90 (south) to 90 (north). Pins without a valid latitude and longitude are skipped.

property.caption: Longitude
property.description: Longitude in degrees, from -180 (west) to 180 (east).

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Text shown next to the pin, e.g. the city name.

property.caption: Pin color
property.description: Fill color of the pins (e.g. "#b91c1c"). Leave empty for the default red.
